definitions.short: Elzabad , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H443. Elzabad אֶלְזָבָד proper name, masculine ( God has given , compare Θεόδωρος זְבַדְיָה זַבְדִּיאֵל, ) a. one of David's band of Gadites 1Chr 12:12 . b. Korahite 1Chr 26:7 .
